# G1: a chain A - P - Q - D of three equal springs between two fixed ends 30 mm apart.
# Closed form: with equal springs the free parts sit evenly spaced, P at 10 and Q at 20, both on y = 0.
board 0 0 60 40
cell A 0 0 1 1 fixed
cell P 3 3 1 1 free
cell Q 25 -4 1 1 free
cell D 30 0 1 1 fixed
net n1 1 A P
net n2 1 P Q
net n3 1 Q D
# Pinned: closed form 10 and 20 (hand), exact rational solve, and an independent conjugate gradient agree to 1e-4.
expect P 10 0
expect Q 20 0
expect cg_steps_at_most 2
